config.language: Language for the visualizer UI and engine messages.
config.language.auto: Follow the editor display language (Indonesian if the editor is set to Indonesian, otherwise English).
config.searchRoots: Folders searched (in order) to resolve `include:project` locally. Each folder may contain repositories laid out by project path, e.g. `/home/me/repos` holding `my-group/ci-templates`. Paths are passed to the engine in the environment where the CI file lives (WSL paths for files opened from WSL). Example: `["/home/me/repos"]`.
config.projectMappings: Explicit mapping from a GitLab project path to a local folder, used before `searchRoots`. Example: `{ "my-group/ci-templates": "/home/me/repos/ci-templates" }`.
config.wslScriptPath: Absolute Linux path to ci_preview.py inside your WSL distro. Leave empty to auto-detect. Used when opening GitLab CI files stored in WSL from a Windows-side editor.
config.pythonPath: Override the Python interpreter command (e.g. 'python3', 'python', or an absolute path). Leave empty to auto-detect.
config.dynamicChildren: Map a dynamic child pipeline (generated at runtime via `trigger:include:artifact`) to a sample YAML file so it can be visualized and simulated offline. Key = bridge job name, artifact file name, or generator job name. Value = path to the sample file (relative paths resolve against the folder of the CI file that contains the bridge job). Example: `{ "trigger-generated": "samples/generated-pipeline.yml" }`.
